summary_en: ITG-G Holdings extended the tender offer period for Kadoya Sesame Mills to November 13, 2026 (39 business days from September 15), with offer price unchanged at 2,514 yen per share and minimum purchase target of 13,847,100 shares (66.65% post-acquisition stake).
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment Regarding Amendment Notice of Opinion Statement Supporting and Recommendation to Tender Shares in Public Tender Offer for Shares of the Company by ITG-G Holdings Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
ITG-G Holdings Co., Ltd. amended the terms of its tender offer for Kadoya Sesame Mills shares. The tender offer period was extended from October 30, 2026 to November 13, 2026, representing 39 business days in total. The offer price of 2,514 yen per share remains unchanged, as does the minimum purchase target of 13,847,100 shares. Upon completion of the minimum purchase, ITG-G Holdings would hold 66.65 percent of outstanding shares (calculated on a post-acquisition basis using 276,213 total voting rights as the denominator, which reflects a 3-for-1 stock split executed in April 2026).

The extension was made following a request from the offeror under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. It was prompted by the publication on October 27, 2026 of a legally binding proposal from Candidate Fund C—a participant in the acquisition process previously disclosed by the company—regarding both a tender offer and subsequent squeeze-out procedures to take the company private.

The stated purpose remains the delisting of Kadoya Sesame Mills. Mitsubishi Corporation, the company's largest shareholder holding 26.88 percent, is expected to be approached during the tender offer period regarding participation in the transaction.
